definition:
Assemble the Section 5.2 architecture-comparison evidence from the archived exp_b1_architecture_law results.

Sources: every copy of s3://ssup-research-079415246777/<prefix>/results/b1_architecture_law/ (synced to RAW).
Cell choice: per (model, objective, condition), the newest file (S3 LastModified) that holds a finished cell
(same rule as the Aug 29 pull_b1.py). Every chosen cell is re-derived from its per-atom file (feat_*.npz):
top-50 and dict-wide sharing are recomputed and must match the archived values.
No new training or evaluation is done here.

usage: python build_sec5_2.py <RAW sync dir> <OUT dir>
